name: आयुष्मान भारत पीएम-जेएवाय
description: World's largest health assurance scheme providing Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to eligible poor and vulnerable families.
benefits: Cashless treatment at empanelled public/private hospitals; no cap on family size/age.
eligibility: Based on SECC deprivation criteria and socio-economic parameters; beneficiaries identified via NHA database. States may expand.
steps: Check eligibility via pmjay.gov.in 'Am I Eligible'.
Visit Ayushman Bharat / CSC kendra with ID.
Visit empanelled hospital; show card at helpdesk.
Cashless admission and treatment; claim settled directly.
